description: Restructuring that keeps behaviour: extracting, moving, renaming and simplifying code. The module map is approved first; the same tests must give the same results at base and head, and the exported surface stays put unless the item declares a change.

exemplars.what: Modules in the repo that already have the shape the refactor aims for (size, file layout, how they export); cite each path and what to copy from it.

proposalArtifact.name: module-map
proposalArtifact.what: module-map.json in the item's evidence folder: {files:[{path, oldPath?, before:[export names], after:[export names]}]}; list every changed JS/TS/Python source file, using oldPath for a rename. List intended surface changes separately as path#name in surfaceChanges.

frozenBaseline: The approved module map, and the test results recorded at base.
